apps._uninstallNote: Uninstall-only entry: we never install Avast, but clients arrive with it. The row upgrade gives the Uninstall tab Avast's own silent Instup path, and the leftover scan offers avastclear - Avast's dedicated deep remover - as a run-this row. Host avastclear.exe under files/removers/ in R2 and pin its real SHA-256 before publishing; the edge must not drop uninstallOnly entries for a missing install hash.
